feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 September 2026 5:20am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 03 September 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland, with a waving weather front moving into the Irish Sea later today.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in a few places, then becoming generally 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain arriving from the west this afternoon, clearing tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor for a time in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 tomorrow morning, then soon becoming 5 or 6 again in the afternoon. Gradually decreasing West 3 or 4 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, moderate or rough for a time, then gradually falling slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
